mintAuthority.summary: Initia iUSD is a wrapper over the AUSD0 representation of Agora AUSD. Users deposit registered AUSD0 collateral into the local iusd-vault and receive iUSD 1:1; AUSD0/LayerZero administration and its bridge mint/burn surface are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: iusd-vault contract (mints iUSD 1:1 against AUSD0 deposits)
controls.capDescription: The iusd-vault mints iUSD 1:1 only after a registered AUSD0 base-token deposit. The optional vault BaseTokenConfig max_balance may bound deposits, but its current numeric value was not returned; the sticky ExtendRef on 0xfd6a07... retains the local iUSD capabilities and the current supply has no metadata-level maximum.
controls.evidence: At Initia height 20754353, the iusd-vault package at 0x2981d795... held the VaultAccount.extend_ref for sticky object 0xfd6a07594842ac5d7501ff55243aff06e4f991f320828be05a4590970145e90a. The vault's current base_tokens table has length 1 and identifies vault::BaseTokenConfig; the item and optional max_balance were not returned by the public table endpoint. The published March 2026 Zellic audit describes user mint as depositing a registered base token before minting iUSD 1:1. AUSD0/LayerZero delivery and administration are separate Bridge Risk evidence.

sources.label: Initia Labs iUSD Vault Zellic audit

controls.label: iusd-vault multisig admin (3-of-4)
controls.evidence: At Initia height 20754353, iusd-vault account 0x2981d795... held the native MultisigWallet named 'iusd-vault', threshold 3 with four weight-1 voting members 0xa5a8f716d5aea6568c64de1831f6e7b37f384761, 0xc24c6072bed56e2c4d8943dc843dce5dd940cfd2, 0x21b8a1fa32ac1422b7837bad31fb0a8ae5146a4c, and 0x6c7034c703abaf8fd1f1006b94ee6470acee150e, plus two weight-0 proposers. The same account held the package MetadataStore, and the vault module remained COMPATIBLE. Transactions from the publishing account therefore can upgrade mint-critical vault function bodies and govern vault configuration; individual registered-AUSD0-backed mints remain deposit-bound and require no vote.

review.evidence: At Initia height 20754353, 0xfd6a07594842ac5d7501ff55243aff06e4f991f320828be05a4590970145e90a remained a sticky Move Object and vault::VaultAccount.extend_ref remained stored at iusd-vault contract 0x2981d795..., so the local vault controls the iUSD capabilities. The current base_tokens table has length 1 and identifies vault::BaseTokenConfig; its item and optional max_balance were not returned by the public table endpoint. The published March 2026 Zellic audit describes the user mint path as depositing a registered base token before minting iUSD 1:1. The vault package was COMPATIBLE and its publishing account was a native 3-of-4 multisig with no separately observed timelock or delay. These native facts support partially-bounded-admin, raiseable, continuous, and attestation-only annotations. AUSD0/LayerZero bridge administration and its package upgrade surface are excluded from Mint Authority and preserved under the reviewed Bridge Risk route.
